Mamily, a family community on the 2008-10 site, under 'Former Investments' in 2011. Acq. (100%) by Super RTL, entry late 2008, full takeover reported 2009-02.

Mercavus, Berlin (founded 2018). HV entered 2019-05; an exit on the 2022-25 lists.
